Shilika Jain embeds as a de-facto comms lead, owns media strategy and runs pitches directly to tier-1 editors at CoinDesk, Forbes, Decrypt and The Block, with 50+ founders placed across six global markets.

mainEntity.name: What is a fractional Head of PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional Head of PR is a principal-level comms operator who works with your company part-time or on a defined scope, acting as your de-facto comms lead without sitting on your full-time payroll. It is the right model for Web3, AI and DePIN founders who need senior strategy and editor relationships, but are not yet at the stage where a $180K–$250K/year VP of Comms is the right allocation.

mainEntity.name: How much does a fractional Head of PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator typically runs $5K–$12K per month, depending on scope, the number of news cycles and whether APAC localisation is included. That compares to $15K–$45K/month for a full agency retainer, or $180K–$250K all-in for a VP of Comms on payroll. A one-off launch sprint is usually $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and deliverables are included with a fractional Head of PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream where the angle warrants it: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Deliverables typically include a 90-day narrative strategy, embargo management, tier-1 pitch execution, KOL coordination and monthly coverage reporting.

mainEntity.name: What does the onboarding and timeline look like for a fractional Head of PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks cover an audit of your press footprint, competitive positioning and one-sentence category narrative. Weeks three and four produce the 90-day comms plan and the first pitch batch. Tier-1 placements typically appear within four to eight weeks of kick-off, though launch timelines depend on your news calendar. The model works best when engaged six to twelve weeks before a major public moment such as a raise, mainnet or TGE.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with a fractional Head of PR from Shilika Jain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form at shilikajain.com/pages/fractional-head-of-pr and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current press footprint, or book a 30-minute call at calendly.com/shilikajain/30min and we will map it out live. No deck required, no account-team intro call.
